## 更新内容 / Changes

会话管理新增单向导入，可把一个或多个 Codex 实例中的全部会话或当前勾选的会话导入指定实例。同 ID 会话按事件合并，预览列出来源、目标处理方式和目标原文件备份；来源目录保持只读，提交前再次核验来源与目标。分段历史会被拦截，来源或目标客户端运行时不会提交。

Session management can now import all conversations or the currently selected conversations from one or more Codex instances into a chosen target instance. Conversations with the same ID are merged by event. The preview lists their sources, target actions, and backups of replaced target files. Source instances remain read-only and are rechecked before commit. Paginated histories are rejected, and imports do not commit while a source or target client is running.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，管理器后台服务会继续保留；请完成工作并等待实例退出后再替换应用。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Manager services remain alive while instances are running; finish active work and wait for instances to exit before replacing the app. Accounts, instances, sessions, and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing, and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux, and other architectures have not been verified.

## 验证来源 / Verification

在临时目录和合成实例上完成桌面流程验证：选择来源与目标、预览、确认客户端已关闭、运行官方 Codex CLI 索引并提交导入；逐字节确认来源 rollout 未变化，目标会话可见，未复制账号文件。桌面烟测也覆盖会话目录选择、内容筛选、复制、索引恢复及 ZIP 导入导出。源码 CI 包含 1451 项测试（1447 通过、4 项条件跳过、0 失败），另通过专用同步事务测试、Go sidecar 测试、类型检查、构建和公开仓库检查。未使用真实会话数据、账号或模型请求。

Desktop verification used temporary directories and synthetic instances: choose source and target, preview, confirm client closure, run official Codex CLI indexing, and commit the import. The source rollout remained byte-for-byte unchanged, the target conversation became visible, and no account files were copied. The desktop smoke also covers session directory selection, content filtering, copying, indexing recovery, and ZIP import/export. Source CI reports 1,451 tests (1,447 passed, 4 conditional skips, 0 failures), alongside dedicated sync transaction tests, Go sidecar tests, type checking, build, and the public repository check. No real conversation data, accounts, or model requests were used.

版本标签：`v0.15.4`。来源提交、对应 GitHub Actions 构建记录及 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 下载链接将在发布完成后补充。

Version tag: `v0.15.4`. The source commit, matching GitHub Actions build, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` download link will be added after the release completes.
